observation.visible_scene: An outdoor playground scene filmed from a low, front-facing angle. A man in a dark plaid shirt and jeans stands behind a blue bucket-style swing seat, gripping the swing's two metal chains, one in each raised hand. A young child in a cream distressed sweater, blue jeans and a pendant necklace sits in the seat, head tilted back looking upward. The background contains autumn trees, a pale building at left, and an adjacent empty swing's pole and chains at right; these remain fixed, indicating a static camera.
visible_changes: The man's gripping hands, which start near the top edge of the frame in the first view, descend steadily through the excerpt to roughly chest/shoulder height by the last view, while still holding the chains.

Correspondingly, the child's body and the blue seat shift downward within the frame; the seat, fully visible at the start, is mostly cut off by the bottom edge toward the end, and the child's head moves from upper-center to lower-center.
The man's torso and head lean slightly forward over the child as the excerpt progresses.
The child's head stays tilted back throughout, but the facial expression changes from a neutral upward gaze to an open smile/laugh.
The child's legs, extended forward in blue jeans at the start, move out of the lower frame as the seat descends.
The chains, the man's grip on them, the child's seated position, the necklace, and the sweater's distressed holes persist unchanged as properties.
The background elements (building, trees, right-side pole and chains) do not move, so the apparent motion belongs to the swing/man/child, not the camera.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the swing is at the front or back of its arc, and how the motion continues before the first frame or after the last frame.
How the child came to be seated and what prompted the man to lower his grip.
uncertain_details: The exact direction of the swing's arc (toward vs. away from the camera) is not fully determinable from the cropped views; only the downward shift of the seat and grip points is clearly supported.
Whether the man is actively pumping the swing or simply letting his hands follow its motion is not visible.
Frame-to-frame jitter and the soft focus make precise positions of the hands and head approximate.
